prek_hooks.name: 🧩 claude-all · Pydantic model contract
prek_hooks.description: Shared config, no dataclass/alias/barrel, verbatim strip, private access.

prek_hooks.name: 🧩 claude-all · No opaque types or masking defaults
prek_hooks.description: No Any/dict model fields, masking defaults, TypedDict or cast.

prek_hooks.name: 🧩 claude-all · Lambda handlers validate their event
prek_hooks.description: Every Lambda handler parses its event into a Pydantic model.

prek_hooks.name: 📝 claude-all · Docstring/comment size budget
prek_hooks.description: Docstrings and comments are optional but size-bounded.

prek_hooks.name: 🐍 claude-all · No identity `or 0` / `or ""` fallbacks
prek_hooks.description: Flags `<identity> or <falsy literal>` (e.g. `org_id or 0`, `token or ""`) that manufacture a fake identity instead of failing on absence.

prek_hooks.name: 🐍 claude-all · No dynamic first-party imports
prek_hooks.description: Flags `importlib.import_module` / `__import__` of a first-party literal module, which hides every attribute access from mypy.

prek_hooks.name: 🐍 claude-all · e2e tests must not bypass real execution
prek_hooks.description: Flags e2e tests that patch or spec first-party code, mutate the environment, or import a production entrypoint to call it in-process.

prek_hooks.name: 🐍 claude-all · No process-global state
prek_hooks.description: Flags module/class-scope state (lazy slots, mutable literals, locks/clients/engines, global statements, cls-mutating classmethods, __new__ singletons, namespace classes) that survives warm starts and leaks across tenants and tests.

prek_hooks.name: 🐍 claude-all · No ad-hoc caches
prek_hooks.description: Flags functools.lru_cache/functools.cache decorators and cachetools/diskcache/aiocache/beaker imports; functools.cached_property is allowed.

prek_hooks.name: 🐍 claude-all · Lazy singleton built under a lock
prek_hooks.description: Flags `global X; if X is None: X = ...` assignments not inside a lock-named with/async with block.
